# Every one of those 1,000.00 US dollars sold at 1.40, less a 5.00 bank
# charge, against the cost basis the purchase opened.
#
# One split claims the difference — the `$residual$` on the gain line — so the
# file imports. The charge beside it is an expense too, which is the point:
# a difference could have landed there, and nothing but the token says it did
# not. That makes this the book to export and come back to when a second claim
# is added to it.
#
# `{usd_basis}` is the guid of the purchase's cost basis, read from
# `fx-balances` after the first import.
2026-06-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-06-01 open Expenses:Bank Charges
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-06-01 * "Sell every dollar at 1.40, less a bank charge"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-1300.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{usd_basis}"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1395.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank Charges 5.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
